name: Ogikubo Aoi
source:
"If you keep smiling, you can be happy."

A girl who is friends with Kazuya and Ritsu. She believes that smiles bring happiness, so she's always wearing a smile.

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara05.html]official website[/url]]
